# TPC-Havoc Q17_v5

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH part_thresholds AS (SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_threshold FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey), qualified_parts AS (SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#23' AND p_container = 'MED BOX') SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly FROM lineitem AS l INNER JOIN qualified_parts AS qp ON l.l_partkey = qp.p_partkey INNER JOIN part_thresholds AS pt ON l.l_partkey = pt.l_partkey WHERE l.l_quantity < pt.avg_threshold
```
